clips.text: Excuse me! I just washed that floor.
clips.script: [warm Long Island accent, sharp, offended] Excuse me! [warm Long Island accent, flat, slower] I just WASHED that floor.

clips.text: Hi, Mom! Is that the cinnamon topping? I've been thinking about that topping since I flew over Kansas.
clips.script: [warm] Hi, Mom! [sniffing, hopeful] Is that the cinnamon topping? [earnest confession] I've been thinking about that topping since I flew over KANSAS!

clips.text: ...so I say to him, "Nice hat." He says, "Thank you." And the hat is steaming.
clips.script: [thick New York accent, storytelling, enjoying himself] ...so I say to him, "Nice hat." [thick New York accent, mild, casual] He says, "Thank you." [thick New York accent, punchline, delighted] And the hat is STEAMING.

clips.text: Deedee keeps offering me apple muffins. I keep saying yes. That's called manners.
